heldout-for-each-policy-number-show-the-.finalSql: WITH prem AS (SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium FROM policy_amount pa JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier), loss AS (SELECT d.Policy_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_incurred_loss FROM claim_coverage cc JOIN policy_coverage_detail d ON d.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date AND d.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment) OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve) GROUP BY d.Policy_Identifier) SELECT p.Policy_Number, concat_ws(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name) AS policyholder_name, prem.total_premium, COALESCE(loss.total_incurred_loss, 0) AS total_incurred_loss FROM policy p LEFT JOIN agreement_party_role apr ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH' LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier LEFT JOIN prem ON prem.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier LEFT JOIN loss ON loss.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier ORDER BY p.Policy_Number
